authority: Hypersystem-Orchestrator source-provenance and redistribution-rights evidence register. This register records evidence and blockers; it does not grant or transfer copyright.
policy: A GitHub URL or public repository visibility is not itself a redistribution licence.
The parent repository's Apache-2.0 licence does not automatically apply to any child plugin source or snapshot.
A pinned submodule proves source identity/commit integration, not package redistribution, parity, dependency or host activation readiness.
USER/PRIVATE Plugin Creator scope is not a licence to export, republish or distribute to additional users/tenants.
A candidate repository licence applies only to material actually covered by that repository and does not establish complete plugin identity or source completeness.
Every package remains non-installable until source, version/parity, redistribution rights, package signature/artifact, dependencies, security and host gates pass.

rights_status_definitions.CLEARED_APACHE_2_0_CONDITIONAL: Apache-2.0 licence text is present; comply with licence conditions and retain notices. This alone does not clear other distribution gates.
rights_status_definitions.NOT_DECLARED: No LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE licence grant was found in the inspected repository tree. Do not assume public visibility permits redistribution.
rights_status_definitions.PRIVATE_NO_LICENSE: Private source with no declared licence; maintain access controls and do not distribute externally without written rights clearance.
rights_status_definitions.REVIEW_REQUIRED_NONCOMMERCIAL: PolyForm Noncommercial applies; commercial use requires separate written permission, and brand/trademark rights are separately governed.
rights_status_definitions.DECLARED_APACHE_2_0_CANDIDATE_ONLY: Apache-2.0 is present in a candidate repository, but candidate completeness/identity is not accepted for package distribution.
rights_status_definitions.NOT_ASSESSED: No canonical Git repository and no independent redistribution licence have been identified.
rights_status_definitions.INHERITED_CANONICAL_RESTRICTED: Legacy redirect inherits the canonical plugin's licence and rights; it is not an independent installable package.
